question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'convert.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options: 

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 adapt
 to suit different conditions or uses. ( उपयोगों के अनुरूप बदलना)
 
 

 reshape
 to shape something again or differently. (किसी चीज़ को फिर से या अलग आकार देना)
 
 

 transfigure
 to change the appearance of a person or thing very much, usually in a very positive and often spiritual way. (किसी व्यक्ति या चीज़ के रूप को बहुत अधिक बदलना, आमतौर पर बहुत सकारात्मक और अक्सर आध्यात्मिक तरीके से)
 
 

 convert
 to (cause something or someone to) change in form or character. ((किसी चीज या किसी के कारण) रूप या चरित्र में परिवर्तन)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Let's look at the sentence: "The *supporters* of the game are so excited that sometimes it may *____________*__ into chaos, confusion and riots."
 
• We can say that the implied meaning of the sentence is the game's supporters are so enthralled that** their excitement sometimes changes its character **into chaos, confusion, and riots.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "convert" to make the sentence meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

​

__Complete passage:__ The Romans had developed a *__(1) taste__* for chariot racing. The *__(2) supporters__* of the game are so excited that sometimes it may __*(3) convert*__ into chaos, confusion and riots. The *__(4) stadium__* in which racing took place was called a circus. The *__(5) largest__* one was the Circus Maximus in Rome, that could hold up to 3,85,000 spectators, which shows the popularity of the sport.
